--- tmp/build.py ---
import os
from PIL import Image
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject

os.makedirs('out', exist_ok=True)

# --- Job 1: feed photo 1080x1350, magenta balloon fully in frame ---
im = Image.open('launch.jpg').convert('RGB')
# balloon bbox: x 2350-2750, y 500-900 -> 4:5 crop 1500x1875 at (1500,0)
crop = im.crop((1500, 0, 3000, 1875))
assert crop.size == (1500, 1875)
out = crop.resize((1080, 1350), Image.LANCZOS)
out.save('out/feed-photo.jpg', quality=92)
print("SAVED out/feed-photo.jpg", out.size)

# --- Job 2: fill permit form and flatten ---
data = {
    'organizer': 'Tidewater Studio',
    'event_date': 'Saturday 5 December 2026',
    'location': 'North Cove Lawn',
    'attendees': 'about 40',
}
reader = PdfReader('permit-form.pdf')
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.append(reader)
for page in writer.pages:
    writer.update_page_form_field_values(page, data, auto_regenerate=True)
# flatten: drop the AcroForm so no editable fields remain (values stay via appearance streams)
if '/AcroForm' in writer._root_object:
    del writer._root_object[NameObject('/AcroForm')]
with open('out/permit-filled.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("SAVED out/permit-filled.pdf")

# --- verify ---
v = PdfReader('out/permit-filled.pdf')
print("VERIFY AcroForm present:", '/AcroForm' in v.trailer['/Root'])
text = v.pages[0].extract_text()
for k in data:
    ok = data[k] in text
    print("VERIFY", k, ok)
print("VERIFY text:", repr(text))


--- tmp/check_ap.py ---
from pypdf import PdfReader
from pypdf.generic import IndirectObject

r = PdfReader('out/permit-filled.pdf')
page = r.pages[0]
for a in page.get('/Annots'):
    o = a.get_object()
    print('T', o.get('/T'), 'V=', repr(o.get('/V')), 'AP=', 'AP' in o or '/AP' in o)
    ap = o.get('/AP')
    if ap:
        n = ap['/N'].get_object()
        try:
            data = n.get_data()
        except Exception as e:
            data = repr(e)
        print('  AP N data:', data[:200])
# check field tree objects
import re
raw = open('out/permit-filled.pdf', 'rb').read()
print('has "Tidewater" in file:', b'Tidewater' in raw)
print('has /V entry:', re.findall(rb'/V\s*/\([^)]*\)', raw))
print('has /AP entry:', len(re.findall(rb'/AP', raw)))


--- tmp/final.py ---
from PIL import Image
import fitz, os

im = Image.open('out/feed-photo.jpg')
print('FEED', im.size, im.format)

d = fitz.open('out/permit-filled.pdf')
print('PERMIT pages:', d.page_count)
root = d.pdf_catalog()
acro = d.xref_get_key(root, 'AcroForm')
print('PERMIT AcroForm key:', acro)
# annotations still present as static text
p = d[0]
print('PERMIT annots:', len(p.annots()) if p.annots() else 0)
print('PERMIT text sample:', ' '.join(p.get_text().split())[:150])

for f in ('launch.jpg', 'permit-form.pdf', 'event-details.txt'):
    print('ORIG', f, os.path.getsize(f))
for f in ('out/feed-photo.jpg', 'out/permit-filled.pdf'):
    print('OUT', f, os.path.getsize(f))


--- tmp/probe.py ---
from pypdf import PdfReader
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

r = PdfReader('permit-form.pdf')
fields = r.get_fields()
print("PAGES:", len(r.pages))
for k, v in (fields or {}).items():
    print("FIELD", repr(k), "|", v.get('/FT'), "|", repr(v.get('/V')))
for pi, page in enumerate(r.pages):
    for a in (page.get('/Annots') or []):
        obj = a.get_object()
        if obj.get('/Subtype') == '/Widget':
            print("ANNOT", pi, repr(obj.get('/T')), obj.get('/Rect'))

im = Image.open('launch.jpg').convert('RGB')
a = np.asarray(im)
r_, g, b = a[..., 0].astype(int), a[..., 1].astype(int), a[..., 2].astype(int)
mask = (r_ > 140) & (b > 110) & (g < 120) & (r_ - g > 60) & (b - g > 40)
ys, xs = np.where(mask)
print("MAGENTA_PX", int(mask.sum()), "IMG", im.size)
if mask.sum():
    print("BBOX x:", int(xs.min()), int(xs.max()), "y:", int(ys.min()), int(ys.max()))
    # density per 200px cell to find main cluster
    hist = {}
    for x, y in zip(xs[::50], ys[::50]):
        hist[(x // 200, y // 200)] = hist.get((x // 200, y // 200), 0) + 1
    top = sorted(hist.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:8]
    print("TOP_CELLS", top)
